title: sail verdict reads the validate berth's commons copy on a far box
intention: sail.py verdict reads a ticket's validate berth on any box, falling back to the commons copy at CairnCommons/berths/chart/<name> when the instance-space path the bus host wrote is absent here.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: sail.py verdict 46851816800f raised FileNotFoundError on the Dell's instance-space validate berth path, while CairnCommons/berths/chart held the same berth byte-identical; the verdict ran only through a scratch wrapper.
traces_to: Law 1 — a berth already carried to the commons is not re-derived or hand-wrapped on a far box.
how: In cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py verdict(): when Path(ref) is not a file, read roots()['CairnCommons']/berths/chart/<Path(ref).name> (cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.roots); if neither is a file, exit 1 naming both and queue nothing. One new tooth in cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py.

clauses.claim: with the recorded validate berth absent and its commons copy present, sail.verdict drafts every criterion verbatim from the copy and queues once at machines/verdict/queueme
with neither present, sail.verdict exits 1 naming both paths and queues nothing

decisions.text: D1: verdict() falls back to the commons copy under roots()['CairnCommons']/berths/chart when the recorded path is not a file; the recorded path wins when present.
D2: one tooth in the sail proof covers both clauses over the scratch world, with PROVES keys 1 and 2.

measured.saw: FileNotFoundError on ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/validate-20261113T144747-ad12a097996e.json on akienasus; CairnCommons/berths/chart/validate-20261113T144747-ad12a097996e.json present; a wrapper reading the copy got verdict-20261113T165737-8ed4b2ba3550 accepted
